items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Last time I heard Mike Murray, last time I can recall him.

ctx.x: Old drummers, that is the first drummers that inspired you. People like Red Happy you were talking about.

Yeah, Red Happy. Just how they played? They had a lot of good drummers. Mike Murray was very sensational. Very good drummer. They had a tune that the band used to play. And they had a break. They used to make, you know, Mike Murray always carried a lot of contraptions with them, whistles and different kind of ratchets and all that for breaks, you know. And in this particular tune, he had a chain, you know, like they have on the wagons, a horse and wagon, a chain, a horse to the shaft. Well, they take this chain…
